planets.name: Kepler-1542 c
planets.description: Transiting planet of Kepler-1542 with a 2.89-day year, found in 2016.

text.card: Kepler-1542 c crosses its star every 2.89 days and is 0.65 times as wide as Earth, found in 2016.
text.introduction: Kepler-1542 c transits Kepler-1542 every 2.89 days and is 0.65 times as wide as Earth. Orbit and size follow Morton et al. 2016's fit, the archive's default.
text.locator: NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table, default parameter set (pl_refname MORTON_ET_AL__2016): pl_orbper 2.89223021, pl_radj 0.05798912, pl_bmassj 0.000653
